title: Fix Flow Context Menu
description: Unify declarative context-menu specs end-to-end (icons, colors, hover previews, full item sets), fix host mapping that strips richness, and fill incomplete menus in flow, puzzle, and every other app.
summary: Fixed flow context menu: secondary click no longer drags nodes (board engine + React host), and the menu always includes preview/zoom/clear/delete — enriched immediately for the clicked selection so items are not missing while waiting for a plugin round-trip.
